python_learning_progress: These lectures cover Monte Carlo simulation, using repeated random experiments to estimate unknown quantities and understand how sample size and variance affect confidence in an estimate.

They also cover normal distributions, confidence intervals, sampling, the Central Limit Theorem, and standard error, explaining how we can use samples to estimate a population and quantify the uncertainty of those estimates.
